Does manifests/quick.yaml declare any sandboxes? Reply with exactly NONE if it declares none, otherwise the image name it binds.
What is the exact path of the file that registers the built-in tools? Confirm it exists before answering.
Without running anything, list the commands a change to packages/harness must pass before it ships.
Activate the skill that explains how Felix is tested, then say in one sentence why a bare pytest fails here.
